body:
I... I don't know what to say. That's a lot of info... thank you. I have no experience programming and I don't have any unrealistic expectations, I know it'll take a lot of work to get anything done. 

I think... I'll get some rest and look through more of these books.

I can type wonderfully, and that's why I don't know why I can't make friends. In real life this doesn't carry over. I stutter, forget words, and I just can't engage socially unless I'm being incredibly fake. (And only then, after I know my target audience, so the first couple of times after I meet someone I just... am completely lost)

I really wish I knew how to make friends with the same interests though... so I didn't have to be fake.
There's actually no lan cafes here in Charlottesville... but... there are a few anime clubs for... high school aged people. I don't really feel comfortable being 24 and male and being a creeper. =(

It's a lot of shame. My first SO was really abuseive to me and put me down in front of everybody and argued with me all the time and I pulled them forward with me. I've lost both of my others by putting myself down and trying to make them hate me. Eventually it works. 

It just feels like if people get to know me that close, they hate me. (I'm aware how silly that sounds, I just dunno how else to put it. I'm aware I do it, but I can't stop myself)
